title: Tantra of the Great Liberation (Mahanirvana Tantra)
author: Anonymous tantra; introduction and commentary by Arthur Avalon
locator_hints: Introduction: summary of hatha practices incl. trataka (file line c. 5766) and bhutashuddhi with nose-tip gaze (c. 5849)
summary: Checked as a source for yantra gazing with open eyes followed by a held afterimage or closed-eye image. The text treats yantra (31 mentions) as ritual diagram for worship and installation; no passage found where a yantra is gazed at and then held as a seen image. Woodroffe's introduction summarises trataka (unwinking gaze at a minute object until tears) and a bhutashuddhi step of meditating on lunar brilliance while gazing at the nose-tip, both briefly and without reports of seen light.
why_relevant: Lead for yantra gazing; negative result recorded.
notes: No free source located for yantra gazing with afterimage retention; this remains a gap.
